title: Audiocue walking study
description: A mobile brain/body imaging (MoBI) dataset of 18 participants walking on a treadmill at constant speed while stepping in time to an auditory tone sequence. Participants adapted step length and rate to occasional shifts in the tempo of the pacing stimulus, to a faster or slower tempo. The dataset supports study of cortical dynamics during gait adaptation.
methods_description: Participants walked on a treadmill at constant speed and synchronized their steps to an auditory pacing sequence, adjusting step length and rate after occasional tempo shifts to faster or slower. Full methodological details are given in the associated scientific article.
